title: Ramsons RHW 200
subtitle: Horizontal Washing Machine (Side-Loading Stainless Steel)

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The RHW 200 is a 200 kg-capacity horizontal (side-loading) washing machine from Ramsons' RHW range (15/30/50/75/100/150/200), available with manual, logic, or microprocessor control. Wet-processing (washing) of linen and garments with a raised door design (above drum center) for improved liquor holding/loading ratio and a calibrated water-level indicator.
applications: Garment wet-processing at higher (200 kg) batch capacity

overviewDescription: Made by Ramsons Garment Finishing Equipment Pvt. Ltd. (Bengaluru, Karnataka, India). Horizontal side-loading drum with inner basket, outer drum, end plates, safety guards, and control panel in stainless steel. Reduction pulley or gearbox-and-pulley system with hot-forged end flange shafts. Heating by steam, electric, or direct gas.

finalNotes:
• Phase 1 PASS — The nameplate and the dealer listing independently cross-confirmed basket volume (resolving the earlier flagged unit-labeling error — the dealer-listed 'mm' was a typo for litres) and full machine dimensions. • This was the only machine of the five Ramsons entries to reach a clean PASS verdict; the other four remain PARTIAL PASS due to source conflicts or single-source fields.
